rules.name: cs-01-discovery
rules.sql: SELECT value_date, count(*) AS cache_rows, count(DISTINCT trade_id) AS trades, max(created_timestamp) AS built, max(updated_timestamp) AS updated FROM dbsystemuat.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table_cfs GROUP BY value_date ORDER BY value_date DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT value_date, count(*) AS cache_rows, count(DISTINCT trade_id) AS trades, max(created_timestamp) AS built, max(updated_timestamp) AS updated FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' GROUP BY value_date ORDER BY value_date DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT business_unit, value_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS'
